_comment: Synthesized TCS Senior Engineer scenario. TCS is a services company — band.hasEquity=false. The failure mode this fixture pins: AI offers ESOPs/RSUs to TCS candidates because it doesn't read the band's hasEquity flag. Real candidates would catch this immediately and lose trust ('TCS doesn't even give ESOPs'). Pre-fix, equity tokens leaked because the prompt didn't disambiguate equity-band vs non-equity-band; the detector forces this asymmetry to be visible.

turns._label: TCS turn-2 leaks ESOPs even though TCS gives no equity
turns.llmOutput: For the Senior Engineer role at TCS, we'd like to extend ₹14 LPA total CTC. We can also discuss ESOPs vesting over 4 years as part of the total compensation. How does this initial offer align with your expectations?
I understand. Let me see what flexibility I have. I can stretch to ₹24 LPA total CTC — that's the absolute top of what I can approve.
So, for the Senior Engineer role at TCS, we'd like to extend an offer at ₹14 LPA total CTC. Happy to walk you through the structure if you'd like — but first, how does the number land for you?
